summary.text: Critical VPP-SPINDLE3-TEMP alert: Spindle 3 reached 64.2 against the 60.0 limit (4.2 over) and was still at least 61.0 in the last 10 s bucket. 3 of 15 parts in lot TM-HS12-261120-211 are at risk. Alert history was unavailable.

quarantine.rationale: The rule requires a QA hold on parts machined outside the validated 60 °C limit. These 3 parts' cuts overlapped the excursion. The lot row lists 12 other parts as releasable.

cmm_inspection.scope: CMM the 3 at-risk parts of lot TM-HS12-261120-211 (DHR-TM-HS12-261120-211) for stem taper and neck geometry, the risk named in the rule. No CMM results exist yet.

ncr.rationale: A validated process parameter was exceeded (64.2 vs 60.0). The rule requires an NCR. The alert row proposes NCR-20261120-173748-CE10.

maintenance_request.rationale: Spindle 3 temperature kept rising for about 30 s after the limit was crossed. The last spindle inspection on record was 2026-09-01, so a maintenance check is advised.

risk_narrative.text: The model (pharma_twin.ml.spindle_risk, synthetic, v3) scores this episode 87%. The main drivers are the 5-minute spindle temperature slope (contribution 0.41) and vibration RMS (0.22). It is advisory only and does not replace CMM results.

steps.action: Place the at-risk parts of lot TM-HS12-261120-211 on QA hold, as the rule requires. Record the hold against DHR-TM-HS12-261120-211.
Request CMM inspection of the 3 at-risk parts for stem taper and neck geometry before any disposition.
Open NCR NCR-20261120-173748-CE10 for the Spindle 3 excursion (64.2 vs 60.0 limit, PS-TM-MILL-HS-003 rev C).
Inspect Spindle 3 for the cause of the temperature rise. The last inspection (2026-09-01) re-verified thermal compensation per OQ-TM-CNC1-014.
Do not start further cuts on Spindle 3 until temperature is confirmed back within the 60 °C limit. The last reading bucket was still at least 61.0.
Review the excursion against PQ-TM-HS12-022 and OQ-TM-CNC1-014 and assess whether the validated state still holds.
After CMM results, record the disposition of lot TM-HS12-261120-211. The projected right-first-time of 72.73% is provisional because no CMM results exist yet.
